name: monk
lore:
Observe the ascetic in their natural habitat: the wind-swept peak or the silent, sun-drenched courtyard. The Monk is a living conduit of *ki*, the vital energy that pulses through the world’s veins. Unlike the armored brawler, they move with a predator’s grace and a philosopher’s restraint. Their ecology is one of equilibrium; they take only what is needed, dwelling in the spaces between society and the wild.

In behavior, they are paradoxes. They seek stillness through meditation, yet their strikes are a blur of kinetic fury. They do not carry steel, for their calloused knuckles and honed shins are deadlier than any blade. Whether wandering the dusty roads as humble pilgrims or guarding ancient secrets in mountain fastnesses, they remain masters of the self—an internal fortress that no siege engine can breach.
